entities.name: MICO indication
entities.description: Information element indicating Mobile Initiated Connection Only mode preference and acceptance.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message used by UE to initiate registration procedure with the network.

entities.name: UE included MICO indication IE
entities.description: Condition where the UE includes the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: Network supports and accepts MICO mode
entities.description: Condition where the network supports and accepts the use of MICO mode.

entities.name: Network includes MICO indication IE
entities.description: Network behavior to include the MICO indication IE in the response message.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain the MICO indication IE.
Network includes MICO IE only if UE included it in REGISTRATION REQUEST.
Network includes MICO IE only if it supports and accepts MICO mode.
Both conditions must be satisfied for network to include MICO IE.
